verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's product page says the RTX PRO 6000 is optimized for CUDA-X libraries (RAPIDS) and that its Blackwell FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates TensorFlow and PyTorch work. Hands-on community reports show CUDA inference workloads running on the card, including CUDA reinstalls during debugging and 41k tok/s. One critic notes that as an SM120 part it lacks tmem/tcgen05 and that key libraries focus on SM100. That narrows library coverage but does not contradict CUDA support. Missing for 10: an explicit CUDA toolkit compute-capability or supported-GPU listing naming this part, and documented library coverage for SM120-specific features.
